Moriden America supplies the North American automotive industry with decorative and functional trim parts such as trunk trim, shift boots, seat upholstery, mat floors, rear seat backs, and tonneau covers.
Its customers are vehicle manufacturers and tier suppliers seeking lightweight, high-strength composites and flexible production that can respond quickly to changing model requirements.
